dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid and symmetrical convergence of the lateral margins from the mid-body toward a narrow, pointed posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None; lateral margins exhibit smooth, continuous convex curvature without visible indentations or protrusions.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal field with subtle low-intensity shading at the lateral peripheries.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal ridge along the posterior dorsal midline, creating a distinct linear shadow-casting feature.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast dark aperture (blowhole) visible at the anterior dorsal position.
